pair.title: Connect to OnlyCat
pair.lead: This app talks to your OnlyCat account in the cloud. It needs an API key.
pair.step1: Open the OnlyCat app on your phone.
pair.step2: Go to Account and turn on Developer Mode.
pair.step3: Open API Keys and create a key for Homey.
pair.step4: Copy it and paste it below — it is only shown once.
pair.warn: An OnlyCat API key has full access to your OnlyCat account, and there is no way to limit it. Make a key just for Homey so you can revoke it on its own later.
pair.empty: Paste your OnlyCat API key first.
pair.none: That key works, but there are no cat flaps on the account.
